name: Order Verification Workflow
script_code:
<script>
assignSessionVar("user_email",  source);

whenEvent('render:finish', function () {
  const caseOptionsMap = {
    'Customer Pay': [
      "Item didn't arrive in time",
      "Buyers Remorse",
      "Overage",
      "Rescue",
      "Refused Shipment",
      "Reconsignment",
      "Shipped too soon"
    ],
    'Global Pay': [
      "Wrong Item Ordered",
      "Incorrect Shipping Address",
      "Incorrect Quantity",
      "Missing Item(s)",
      "Missing Assembly Hardware/Parts",
      "Missing Hardware/Parts",
      "Shortage (DS)",
      "Shortage (DC)",
      "Wrong Item Shipped",
      "Item Received Doesn't Match Website",
      "Wrong Account Used",
      "Duplicate Order",
      "Vendor Cost incorrect"
    ],
    'Vendor Pay': [
      "Wrong Item Ordered",
      "Incorrect Shipping Address",
      "Incorrect Quantity",
      "Missing Item(s)",
      "Missing Assembly Hardware/Parts",
      "Missing Hardware/Parts",
      "Shortage (DS)",
      "Shortage (DC)",
      "Wrong Item Shipped",
      "Item Received Doesn't Match Website",
      "Wrong Account Used",
      "Duplicate Order",
      "Vendor Cost incorrect"
    ]
  };

  const subCaseInput = document.querySelector('#subCase');
  if (!subCaseInput) return;

  let allowedSubCases = [];
  let lastParentCase = '';

  setInterval(() => {
    const parentCase = (window.form_data?.parentCase || '').trim();
    if (parentCase && parentCase !== lastParentCase) {
      lastParentCase = parentCase;
      allowedSubCases = caseOptionsMap[parentCase] || [];

      const currentSubCase = subCaseInput.value.trim();
      if (!allowedSubCases.includes(currentSubCase)) {
        subCaseInput.value = '';
        subCaseInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
        if (window.form_data) {
          window.form_data.subCase = '';
        }
      }
    }
  }, 100);

  subCaseInput.addEventListener('focus', () => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const menu = document.querySelector('.v-list');
      const items = menu?.querySelectorAll('.v-list-item') || [];

      if (menu && items.length && allowedSubCases.length) {
        items.forEach(item => {
          const label = item.innerText.trim();
          item.style.display = allowedSubCases.includes(label) ? '' : 'none';
        });
        clearInterval(interval);
      }
    }, 100);
  });
});
</script>
